listing.name: Commissioned Crews
listing.aiSummary: Grants unique ship bonuses based on the faction you are currently commissioned to, making mid-game commissions more worthwhile.

description:
Quote

A solution to the mid-game problem of not needing commissions and enhancing your lore immersion by granting special characteristics depending on what faction you're commissioned by. Perhaps it is also an encouragement for you to try out new faction starts...

Commissioned Crews

is a mod designed to make commissions more worthwhile to hold onto even in the mid-game and late-game by granting ship bonuses that are only unique to the faction you are commissioned to. However, if you get decommissioned by whatever means, you'll lose that bonus! This mod should be compatible with everything including your saves! It's also not as performance-intensive as a faction mod at all.

How does it work?

Simple.

Courtesy of 123nick for the video.

Dock at a Market. That's all you need to do. Unless there's a special circumstance that prevents this check from happening (apparently starting ships aren't being checked for odd reasons) A certain hull mod checks if there's a commission and gets replaced by a commissioned crew bonus to a ship you put the hull mod in. It does a fleet-wide check so you only need to do it once if you're not adding any new ships!

Disclaimer

Disclaimer: This fleet-check may not work properly when you first begin the game. You may have to use the hullmod as a backup fleet check. This is because ships that are given to the player aren't "exactly" alive until they encounter their first combat, change weapons, or anything to make them alive!

[close]What if there are some ships I JUST DON'T WANT THE BONUSI got you covered. Just apply this bonus and the ship won't be tagged for any future commissioned bonus hullmod.

[close][close]

I'm convinced, what bonuses do I get from commissioning with the factions?

For the Vanilla 5 Factions that you can actually commission withHegemony[close]Persean League[close]Luddic Church[close]Tri-Tachyon[close]Sindrian Diktat[close][close]For those who like Nexerelin... you get access to 2 more factions bonus and a unique mechanic...

For you who enjoy more than 1 of these bonuses...Your voice has been heard! If you have Nexerelin and have allied with several factions. You will now receive their Commissioned Crew bonus when you take up the United We Stand Hullmod!

[close][close]

For modders: Wait, but what about MODDED factions?  :-XTo users, you may have to wait for your favorite mod author to make support. Support is very easy to support for modders. You can download

this example code to see how Hegemony gets its hullmod.

. You just need to remember to put something in the TechpriestCommission.csv to align with the corresponding faction string and hullmod string while making sure your hull mod has code (in the example) to remove itself when the player is no longer commissioned to the faction. The hullmod should somewhat encourage players for receiving a commission with them (straight debuffs are ? but buffs for a debuff are fine). Support is extremely stable at the moment.

Once you have support, there should be little need to maintain support aside from balancing out the commissioned hull mods. If you want some ideas, you may check out what the supported modded factions have as their bonuses. For mine, all of the vanilla factions are open-sourced, so you may peek to how I made the code work.

Quote from: Wispborne on September 20, 2019, 12:53:12 PM

1. In `data/hullmods/hull_mods.csv`,
    - [ ] Under `id`, change `CHM_hegemony` to whatever hull mod id you want.
    - [ ] Under `script`, change `data.scripts.hullmods.CHM_hegemony` to use your hull mod id instead.
    - [ ] If desired, change any other values, like the `desc`. 

2. In `data/scripts/hullmods`,
    - [ ] Rename `CHM_hegemony.java` to `<your hull mod id>.java`.
    - [ ] Inside that file, replace `class CHM_hegemony` with `class <your hull mod id>`.
    - [ ] Inside that file, replace `hegemony` with your faction id.

3. In `data/config/CommissionBonus/TechpriestCommission.csv`,
    - [ ] Change `hegemony` to your faction id.
    - [ ] Change `CHM_hegemony` to your hull mod id.

4. Optionally you may want to add a tip, hullmod font colors, but that's only if users have this mod so they may get confused if they take a commission and they don't get anything.

[close]If you activate this mod and check the codex...With a user's mod list, you can go into the Codex, look for Crews (Commissioned) to find a list of all the available Commissioned Crews you can access! No more needing to find out if a faction supports it or if a big content mod supports it, and does not look like it has it!

[close]Archived Commissioned CrewsNo longer used, unfortunately! I don't have the activity to maintain the list anymore. See above spoiler!

aiDescription: Adds special hullmod bonuses that activate when you hold a commission from a specific faction, replacing standard hullmods on ships. The bonuses vary by faction and can include effects like armor plating, missile damage, or flux capacity. If you are decommissioned, the bonus is lost until you dock at a market. The mod also supports allied faction bonuses through a 'United We Stand' hullmod and includes codex integration for supported factions.

changelog.1.999999ggggg:
Updated for 0.98a
Reworked League Commissioned Crew bonus to have officer-based effects.
Reworked Sindrian Diktat Commissioned Crew bonus to affect energy+beam weapons.
Commissioned Crews hullmods supported by mod authors should automatically appear in the Codex. No need to use the forum thread to check anymore!
Added LunaLib stuff
changelog.1.9/1.92/1.93/1.9999:
Adjusted volume of some background noise when you dock -> Added Custom Sound Effect of CC from @MesoTroniK [link: https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?action=profile;u=2253]
Cleaner more optimized code from SirHartley that now fixes the frozen screen market load crash.
Rewritten tips from Avanitia.
Added CC icons from Mayu.
United We Stand now considers your commissioned faction's alliances now.
All Hullmods can now be applied without re-docking
Hegemony's Armor Plating Bonus rescaled from 40/60/80/100 to 55/70/85/100.
Luddic Church's Missile Damage Bonus no longer deals an extra +20%/15%/10%/5%, but +30%/25%/20%/15% damage to shields now.
Sindria's Timid/Cautious bonus reworked now increase shield raise rate and turn rate.
Sindria's Aggressive/Reckless bonus reworked now increases DPS to weapon and engines.
Pirate's Sensor Profile Reduction reduced from -25% to -20%.
Pather's CR Reduction reduced from -20% to -15%.
Reworked Tri-Tachyon's CC Bonus (FINALE): -17% Overload Duration.
Added VNSector Support
Last Update before Starsector 0.95
BIG MODDER'S TOOL: Can add UNLIMITED hullmods under the same faction entry now! NOT RESTRICTED TO ONE HULLMOD PER FACTION.
changelog.1.8:
When your commissioned faction ally with another faction, you can take United We Stand hullmod and you'll now receive that alliance hullmod.
League Commissioned Crew now reduces minimum crew count by 10%.
Assigned techtypes so you can exclude and stuff idk UI stuff.
